notablePrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.You control at least two additional enchantments, and one additional creature without summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting any other creature you control without summoning sickness.
Cast Out of Time by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Out of Time enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Out of Time from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Out of Time trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
